setup_sql: CREATE TABLE test_users(id INT, name VARCHAR(50));
CREATE TABLE test_orders(id INT, user_id INT, amount FLOAT);

test_cases.name: INNER JOIN基本测试
test_cases.sql: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM test_users u INNER JOIN test_orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

test_cases.name: LEFT JOIN测试
test_cases.description: 验证LEFT JOIN包含左表所有记录
test_cases.sql: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM test_users u LEFT JOIN test_orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

test_cases.name: JOIN条件测试
test_cases.sql: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM test_users u INNER JOIN test_orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.amount > 150;

test_cases.name: 多表JOIN测试
test_cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_users u INNER JOIN test_orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
